targets.queryText:
SELECT
    CAST(seq_size AS TEXT) as "Sequence length",
    COUNT(*) as "Sequences"
FROM (
    SELECT inputid, COUNT(*) as seq_size
    FROM requests
    WHERE runid = "$runid"
    GROUP BY inputid
)
GROUP BY seq_size
ORDER BY seq_size
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
    CAST(seq_size AS TEXT) as "Sequence length",
    COUNT(*) as "Sequences"
FROM (
    SELECT inputid, COUNT(*) as seq_size
    FROM requests
    WHERE runid = "$runid"
    GROUP BY inputid
)
GROUP BY seq_size
ORDER BY seq_size

panels.description: Cumulative reasons why input sequences either completed or stopped early.

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', timestamp) as time, sequences_completed_total as "Completed", sequences_missing_backreference_total as "Missing backreference", sequences_crash_or_validation_total as "Crash or validation", sequences_transport_error_total as "Transport error", sequences_request_build_error_total as "Request build error" FROM stats WHERE runid = "$runid" ORDER BY timestamp
